API ReferenceZscaler Client Connector APIPublic API ControllerUpdate the properties of the application profile using profile ID
Update the properties of the application profile using profile ID
PATCH
https://api.zsapi.net/zcc/papi/public/v1/application-profiles/:profileId

Update the properties of the application profile using profile ID.

Note:You can update only the following allowlisted properties. For array or comma-separated strings, ensure to include existing values along with the new values.

packetTunnelExcludeList
packetTunnelExcludeListForIPv6
packetTunnelIncludeList
packetTunnelIncludeListForIPv6
vpnGateways
sourcePortBasedBypasses
disableParallelIpv4AndIPv6
dnsPriorityOrderingForTrustedDnsCriteria
useDefaultAdapterForDNS
updateDnsSearchOrder
disableDNSRouteExclusion
enforceSplitDNS
bypassDNSTrafficUsingUDPProxy
truncateLargeUDPDNSResponse
prioritizeDnsExclusions
packetTunnelDnsExcludeList
packetTunnelDnsIncludeList
dnsPriorityOrdering
customDNS
appServiceIds
bypassAppIds
bypassCustomAppIds
groups
groupAll
userIds
logoutpassword
uninstallpassword
disablepassword
exitPassword
zdxDisablePassword
zdDisablePassword
zpaDisablePassword
zdpDisablePassword
zccRevertPassword
zccFailCloseSettingsExitUninstallPassword
deviceType
Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
profileId
string
REQUIRED

ID of the profile

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
active
int32

Indicates whether the policy is active.

appServiceIds
string[]

IDs of the application services associated with the policy.

appServices
object[]
bypassAppIds
string[]

The IDs of the applications configured to bypass policy enforcement.

bypassApps
object[]
bypassCustomAppIds
string[]

The IDs of the custom applications configured to bypass policy enforcement.

bypassCustomApps
object[]
description
string

The description of the application profile.

deviceGroupIds
string[]

The ID of the device group.

deviceGroups
object[]
deviceType
string

The type of device.

Possible values: [DEVICE_TYPE_ANDROID, DEVICE_TYPE_IOS, DEVICE_TYPE_LINUX, DEVICE_TYPE_MAC, DEVICE_TYPE_OTHER, DEVICE_TYPE_WINDOWS]

disasterRecovery
object
enableDeviceGroups
byte

Indicates whether device groups are enabled.

groupAll
int32

Specifies if the rule applies to all device groups.

groupIds
string[]

Specifies the device group IDs to which the rule applies.

groups
object[]
highlightActiveControl
byte

Indicates whether an outline around an actively selected control is displayed.

id
int64

ID of the profile.

logFileSize
int32

Specifies the maximum size of the log file.

logLevel
int32

Specifies log severity (Low 0, Normal 1, and High 2)

logMode
int32

Specifies the scope of the logs.

name
string

Specifies the name of the application profile.

notificationTemplateContract
object
notificationTemplateId
int64
onNetPolicy
object
pac_url
string

The PAC URL.

policyExtension
object
policyToken
string

Specifies the token key required to download policy for Zscaler Client Connector.

reactivateWebSecurityMinutes
string

Specifies the time, in minutes, for Zscaler Client Connector to reactivate internet security if the user turns it off.

reauth_period
string

The automatic ZPA reauthentication time (in seconds).

ruleOrder
int32

The order of the app profile rule. The rule order reflects the order of precedence among configured profile policy rules and helps determine which rule the app downloads for a user upon enrollment. Precedence is based on ascending numerical order.

sendDisableServiceReason
byte

Description about why a Zscaler service (e.g., ZIA, ZPA, ZDX) was disabled on a device.

tunnelZappTraffic
int32

Indicates whether Tunnel Zapp Traffic is enabled. When enabled, Zscaler Client Connector tunnels internal traffic through Zscaler, and continues to send PAC requests directly.

userIds
string[]

Specifies the list of user IDs to whom the policy is assigned.

users
object[]
ziaPostureConfig
object
